messages:
omar: quick question — we want to introduce an 'observer' role for investigations that can read sanitized SIEM exports and log views for 90d. goal: reduce ad-hoc raw log grants during vuln triage. @jess @lex any red flags from compliance?
jess: I like the idea. couple of things: must ensure the observer cannot request raw unmasked exports. only view-level. also need audit events when they access any scrubbed view.
lex: Agree. Also KMS considerations: if any export path requires key unwrap (for snapshots), that should remain gated to JIT flow. observers should never get kms:Decrypt on CMKs.
omar: good. implementation thought: create 'log.observer' role that maps to a read-only principal in the SIEM proxy, with access to pre-defined dashboards and scrubbed export endpoints only. no downstream export tokens. we could auto-inject an access_notice banner on view load.
mike: +1. For incident response exceptions (e.g., vuln triage needing elevated access) we should formalize a 72h emergency lease that requires an approver and records the justification. post-lease we auto-revoke and emit an audit ticket.
jess: can we combine with existing JIT KMS proxy? Proposal: request flow triggers a ticket in PagerDuty for approver, once approved the KMS proxy mints a timeboxed unwrap token scoped to a single snapshot and logs the reason. env: staging/prod separation required.
lex: sample policy snippet (pseudo):
```
policy:
  role: log.observer
  allowed_actions: [view:dashboards, view:scrubbed_exports]
  denied_actions: [export:raw, kms:Decrypt]
```
we also need to add a 'justification' field captured in the audit line for every access.
omar: thanks. who owns the ticket to wire this up? I can do the SIEM proxy side but need help from infra to add the role and from security for approval workflow.
jess: I'll own the approval + audit bits. will draft the ticket template today. template should include scope, justification, approver, expiry (72h default), and postmortem flag.
mike: infra side - I'll create the IAM role mapping and stub the OPA rule. ETA EOW unless higher priority.
security-bot: Reminder: Any change to roles that affects audit logs must include a changelog entry and notify compliance@redwood. See https://internal.company/policy/log-access for required fields.
omar: perfect. Jess, can you paste the ticket template here when it's ready? I'll start the SIEM proxy PR and link it.
jess: will do. starting now — will post template + small runbook for approvers (how to verify justification). :thumbsup:
mike: ping me when PR is up, I'll wire the OPA rule and add tests for deny export:raw.
lex: one more ask — include a retention-exception tracker so any approval that extends retention beyond 90d is recorded with legal signoff.
omar: good call. will include retention-exception checkbox in the request. thanks all.
